framework: Phase 7D Before / After Comparative Analysis (Phase 6 Equal 25% vs Phase 7D 25/35/40)
findings: Zero players experienced changes exceeding 10 contribution points. The largest adjustment occurred for lower-order bowler B Kumar (-7.07 pts), where situational difficulty no longer compensates for low output. Top batters experienced minor to moderate adjustments (-1.0 to -5.4 pts) perfectly consistent with Model A sensitivity predictions.

comparisons.reason_for_change: Elite top-order accumulator (973 runs, 4 hundreds). Score adjusted from 76.10 to 71.80 (-4.30 pts). His team-state impact is exceptional (P3 = 80.94), driven by high active partnership share (carrying RCB top order) and consistent EFS acceleration. Openers continuing through the powerplay into the middle overs receive valid middle-over score (78.78).

Dynamic middle-order anchor/finisher (687 runs, SR 168.8). Score adjusted from 60.74 to 55.35 (-5.39 pts). Maintains elite high-pressure contribution (88.75) and strong positive raw contribution (+11.65). Inherited context (P1=43.15) no longer artificially inflates matches with early platform stability.

Dominant captain/opener (848 runs, SR 151.4). Score adjusted smoothly from 70.21 to 69.16 (-1.05 pts). Exceptional P3 (78.05) and P2 (75.16). His team contribution share increased from 36.34% to 45.53%, correctly reflecting extreme reliance of SRH's batting order on Warner.

Orange Cap 2022 centurion (863 runs, 4 hundreds). Score adjusted from 68.23 to 66.88 (-1.35 pts). Balanced profile across all three pillars: P1=61.24, P2=70.81, P3=66.99. Middle-over contribution is 78.95.
Top-order accumulator 2023 (890 runs, 3 hundreds). Score adjusted from 64.18 to 62.75 (-1.43 pts). High P2 (69.31) and P3 (68.17) with valid middle-over presence (72.42).
Opening batter 2016 (489 runs, 5 fifties). Score increased slightly from 58.01 to 58.76 (+0.75 pts). Benefited from strong P3 (64.63) in successful run chases (P2=62.56, P1=44.06).
Pure specialist bowler with 100% DNB (13 DNB matches, 0 batting innings). Scores, shares, and phase metrics strictly preserved as NULL.

Lower-order bowler with 8 batting innings and 9 DNBs. Under previous Phase 5B model, high situational difficulty (P1=60.71) and par counterfactual (P4=50.0) inflated his score to 51.21 despite modest scoring output (43 runs, P2=36.96, P3=40.04). Under Phase 7D (25/35/40), batter execution (P2) and team-state impact (P3) carry 75% weight, preventing situational difficulty from artificially inflating low-output stays. He had no middle-over opportunities, correctly returning NULL for middle-over contribution.
